title: Uilma Rudolf 1960 yilda bitta Olimpiadada 3 oltin olgan

scenes.text: 1960 yil Rim Olimpiadasida Uilma Rudolf 3 ta oltin medal yutdi.
Bolaligida u poliomielit bilan og'rigan edi.
Bir necha yil oyog'ida temir tayanch bilan yurgan.
scenes.keywords: child legs walking close up vintage

scenes.text: Maktabda basketbol o'ynadi, keyin yugurishga o'tdi.
Rimda u 100 va 200 metrda hamda estafetada birinchi bo'ldi.
Qanday boshlaganing emas, keyin nima qilganing muhim.

description: 1960 yil Rim Olimpiadasida Uilma Rudolf 100 metr, 200 metr va 4x100 estafetada 3 ta oltin medal yutdi. Bolaligida u poliomielit bilan og'rigan va bir necha yil oyog'ida tayanch bilan yurgan. Sen qaysi qiyinchilikni bahona qilib yuribsan?
source: Biography.com: Wilma Rudolph (polio, leg brace, three golds in 100 m, 200 m and 4x100 m relay at Rome 1960), https://www.biography.com/athlete/wilma-rudolph ; NBC Sports: Wilma Rudolph and the Rome Olympics, https://nbcsports.com/olympics/news/wilma-rudolph-rome-olympics ; EBSCO Research Starters: Rudolph Becomes the Fastest Woman in the World, https://www.ebsco.com/research-starters/history/rudolph-becomes-fastest-woman-world . Note: sources differ on how long she wore the brace (about until age 8 to 12), so the script says 'bir necha yil'.
